name: youtube-easy
description: Upload and manage YouTube through a dedicated browser login. No API keys, OAuth client, or copied cookies.
long_description: YouTube Easy uses a dedicated local Helium, Chrome, Edge, or Chromium profile and normal Google/YouTube sign-in. It drives YouTube Studio through loopback-only CDP, verifies important fields before final writes, coordinates duplicate protection across separate processes, and returns UNCERTAIN instead of risking repeated ambiguous writes.
